# Joanna Stadwiser Voice Over

> Joanna Stadwiser is a voice over artist for network TV promos, movie trailers, commercials, narration and radio imaging, recording from her home studio in San Diego, CA.

## Pages

- [Home](https://joannastadwiser.com/): Demos (commercial, promo, trailer, TV affiliate and radio imaging), featured video work, selected credits, bio, studio equipment and contact details.
- [Demos](https://joannastadwiser.com/#demos): Audio demos by category.
- [Featured Work](https://joannastadwiser.com/#featured): Video examples of broadcast and commercial work.
- [Selected Credits](https://joannastadwiser.com/#credits): Shows, networks and campaigns she has voiced.
- [About](https://joannastadwiser.com/#about): Bio and studio equipment.
- [Contact](https://joannastadwiser.com/#contact): Booking through Atlas Talent Agency (New York and Los Angeles) or directly.

## Key Facts

- Has voiced promos for The Today Show, NBC Nightly News, CBS Mornings and Extra.
- Radio imaging clients range in format from Hot AC to Sports Talk; narration credits include shows on DIY Network and TLC.
- Records from a home studio in San Diego, CA with Source-Connect and phone patch.
- Represented by Atlas Talent Agency in New York and Los Angeles.
